name: CG-MER dyadic multimodal dataset
description: An annotated multimodal dataset and assessment benchmark of spontaneous French dyadic conversations for evaluating conversational and multimodal models (e.g., emotion/behavior recognition).
reputation: A specialized multimodal French dyadic conversation corpus used in multimodal affective-computing research with modest community uptake.
notes: Language-specific (French) and relatively small; annotations are subjective (affect/behavior), which can limit inter-annotator agreement and generalization.
